title: Oven Fresh British Dill Pie And Mash
description: A traditional British dish featuring a silky dill pie served with mashed potatoes, this recipe is macrobiotic-friendly and perfect for a comforting meal. The leaf-wrap-steam method adds a unique twist to this classic recipe.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pot, boil the chopped potatoes until they are tender, then drain and mash with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
In a separate pan, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until the onion is translucent.
Add the chopped fresh dill to the pan and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Roll out the pie crust and fill with the dill and onion mixture, then top with vegetable broth.
Cover the pie with a leaf wrap and steam in the oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the leaf wrap and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Serve the pie with the mashed potatoes and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
